caption: The drawing depicts a spoon shown from three different perspectives: a side view at the top, a top-down view in the center, and a handle-end view to the right. The spoon appears to be rendered in shades of grey and black, with the bowl and handle clearly distinguished by shading and contour lines. The handle, shown to the right, is flat and tapers towards the bowl, with a rectangular mark containing the letters “P.R.” near the end. Below the main illustrations, there is a small inset technical drawing with measurements and angles, presenting additional dimensional information about the spoon’s side and bowl shapes. The drawing is signed "Holger Hansen" towards the lower left corner inside a bordered rectangular area. The entire composition is centered within a larger, slightly yellowed rectangular frame.
title: Spoon
